criteria.validate_if: C3 recall@5 >= C2 (within CI or better) on >=2 tracks AND H2 AND H3
criteria.complement_if: H4 holds on Track B (C5>C2, paired CI excludes 0 after Holm) and directionally on Track A; may be reported alongside any verdict
criteria.partial_if: parity with C2 plus a SIGNIFICANT win over C0 or C1 (state which, changelog-8), AND H2, AND H3-objective
criteria.kill_if: treatment only beats the naive floor (not semantic), OR H2 fails (vocabulary drift), OR H3 fails (readability lost -> propositionization)

hypotheses.H1: C3 recall@k >= C2, and > C1 > C0 at k in {1,3,5,10}
hypotheses.H2: C3 (and C4/C5) hybrid recall@k not reduced vs dense (no vocab drift)
hypotheses.H3: C3 single output rated as readable or better than source; assessed on Track B real prose (Track A rubric floors; objective preserved-term check is A's signal)
hypotheses.H4: C5 (formatted+contextual) recall@5 > C2 (contextual alone), CI excludes 0 after Holm; secondary C4 (formatted+naive) > C0 (naive alone)

criteria.preregistered_expectation: de-duplication is neutral-to-negative for recall (redundancy is robustness); a negative dedup ablation is expected
criteria.prose_rule: any 'beats' claim must be backed by a significant pairwise test (CI excluding 0 after Holm) — changelog-8
